claims.statement: Alarm ALM-31984 on DEP02-B for LOT-1239 reported heater_temp_C 410.62 above FDC limit 403.0 with control limits 493.0 to 507.0 and spec limits 485.0 to 515.0
Heater_temp_C on DEP02-B jumped at 69.6 h LOT-1231 to 411.0 then 411.5 at 71.7 h and 410.62 at 72.0 h, mean_after_pm 408.25 vs mean_before_pm 400.083
FDC summary for DEP02-B shows heater_temp_C baseline_mean 400.09 recent_mean 408.25 delta 8.16 z_score 37.4 while other parameters are normal
Re-measurement of LOT-1239 on MET01 gave mean_A 497.67 range_A 4.91 in_spec true in_control true despite high heater reading
DEP02-B thickness mean_after_pm 500.06 vs mean_before_pm 499.238 last_value 500.97 slope -0.169 per 100 wafers shows no thickening after heater jump
DEP02-B chamber summary n_measured 8 mean_A 499.55 std_A 1.34 min_A 497.98 max_A 501.23 n_ooc 0 n_oos 0 within control

disposition.summary: DEP02-B heater sensor jumped ~8 C after PM (411.0-411.5) but measured thickness after the jump stayed in-control (497.67-501.23), and LOT-1239 measured 497.67 in-control despite high reading. Real heater rise would thicken film; staying in-control points to sensor misreport. Flag sensor, release lot.
